title: Repair the dangling STYLE_NOTES reference in the venture docs
prompt: The venture brief at docs/VENTURE_BRIEF.md cites docs/STYLE_NOTES.md for the gallery's imagery and voice rules, but that file does not exist. Make the docs consistent again with the smallest sensible change: either add a short docs/STYLE_NOTES.md holding the imagery and voice rules the brief promises, or amend the brief so it stops citing a file that is not there. Stay inside docs/ and keep the change small.

criteria.desc: Every docs/ path cited in docs/VENTURE_BRIEF.md resolves
Total diff against the baseline is 10 lines or fewer

notes: R0 journey: a one-file docs fix. The dangling citation is real in the fixture (seed-v1-S ships no docs/STYLE_NOTES.md). The diff budget punishes ceremony: 10 lines covers either fix done plainly.
